title: Bobby Short and his cousin Rudy
summary: Humes praises Bobby Short as a performer. His cousin Rudy, once Debbie Reynolds's musical director, worked with her at the Tiffany Club in Los Angeles. Dance says the Los Angeles years are undocumented.
